name: wordskiis
description: Wordskiis — a little word challenge every day.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-wordskiis-rules "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.test:e2e:friends: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-wordskiis "playwright test --config playwright.friends.config.ts"
scripts.app:android: vite build && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist/downloads',{recursive:true,force:true})" && cap sync android && cap open android
scripts.app:apk: vite build && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist/downloads',{recursive:true,force:true})" && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && cd .. && node scripts/publish-apk.mjs
scripts.app:aab: vite build && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist/downloads',{recursive:true,force:true})" && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
